top_choice_rationale: Cărtărescu's Blinding and Solenoid provide the strongest supplied evidence of a distinctive, sustained prose architecture in which dense patterning makes memory, embodiment and dream formal instruments of a unified metaphysical project. The associated poetry supports the breadth of the oeuvre, though Romanian stylistic texture and full-corpus consistency remain translation and coverage uncertainties.
recusal_note: None apparent from the supplied profile.
